nile_archive:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: mobile game app icon concept selection atlas.
Create ONE square image containing exactly 16 different polished app icon concepts in a precise 4-column by 4-row grid. Every icon is a complete square edge-to-edge painting, equal sized, cleanly separated by narrow neutral dark gutters. No title, no labels, no numbers, no lettering, no logos or watermark anywhere. This is an exploration sheet, not a UI screenshot. Each cell is an independently composed app icon with a LARGE expressive character face dominating, immediately readable at small phone size, appealing adult adventure game art, beautifully painted dimensional lighting, confident silhouettes, rich color contrast, refined illustrated realism with slightly idealized facial features. Vary compositions substantially instead of repeating one portrait with minor recolors: front and three-quarter portraits, facial expression, gaze, prop, lighting and background storytelling. Every cell must still clearly read as the SAME heroine. Eyes stay large and legible, no full-body figures, no tiny scenery replacing the face, no text, no app icon rounded corner mask, no thick decorative borders. Keep focal face within the central safe area. Original artwork, no copied commercial characters.
Game: Nile Archive, a hidden-object mystery in Ptolemaic Egypt, 196 BCE. Input image is a CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY: Nefra, the game's heroine. Preserve her recognizably warm medium-brown skin, dark wavy hair partly tied up, turquoise hairband, dark expressive eyes, ivory linen, turquoise shawl and tasteful lapis-and-gold Egyptian jewelry. She is an archivist's daughter following clues to her missing father and lost papyrus library, an intelligent adventurous young adult, not a queen, no pharaoh crown.
Palette: turquoise Nile water, warm sandstone, lapis blue, papyrus cream and sunset gold.

1. Welcoming direct gaze, turquoise shawl, sunlit Nile behind.
2. Curious three-quarter face with a rolled papyrus near one shoulder, deep lapis background.
3. Intrigued raised eyebrow beside a small golden scarab clue, teal shadows.
4. Confident over-shoulder portrait, ivory linen and gold sunset temple silhouette.
5. Face close-up framed by a softly unfurling papyrus map at lower edge.
6. Warm smiling face, sunlit sandstone arch behind, turquoise shawl sweeping lower corner.
7. Thoughtful sideways glance, softly glowing oil lamp at lower edge, dusk blue background.
8. Excited discovery expression, turquoise scarab seal held prominently near chin.
9. Determined frontal close-up, one broad gold sun disk behind her as background lighting motif.

11. Bright close-up with pink-gold Nile sunset and small felucca sail in background.
12. Gentle knowing smile, blue lotus flower near shoulder, teal-and-gold palette.
13. Curious face plus one small bronze key as story clue, blurred temple doorway.
14. Three-quarter face with gold earrings emphasized, deep blue water and papyrus reeds.
15. Hopeful upward gaze, glowing rolled manuscript at lower edge, midnight turquoise.
16. Iconic centered face, bold turquoise shawl and ivory/gold color blocks, very simple sunlit background.
Keep all compositions elegant, emotionally engaging, and uncluttered. All 16 icons generated together in this single atlas.
